title: Revitalising Singapore's Nightlife Offerings to Boost Tourism and Local Spending in the Sector
what_it_is: Revitalising Singapore's Nightlife Offerings to Boost Tourism and Local Spending in the Sector

sections.label: STB nightlife event collaborations
sections.summary: STB collaborates with nightlife businesses to use STB-supported events to create promotions and experiences attracting local consumers and visitors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: STB also collaborates with nightlife businesses to leverage STB-supported events, such as iLight Singapore, Light to Night Festival, Grand Prix Season Singapore and others to create promotions or special experiences to attract both local consumers and visitors.

sections.label: Support for nightlife association
sections.summary: During COVID and recovery, STB worked closely with the Singapore Nightlife Business Association on support including financial support, grants and wage support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have been working very closely with the Singapore Nightlife Business Association (SNBA) during COVID and during the period of recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, for example, during COVID, we worked closely on providing support including financial support, grants and wage support as well.

sections.label: Nightlife sector transformation cooperation
sections.summary: STB, Enterprise Singapore and Workforce Singapore work with SNBA and other players on nightlife products, sector transformation and workers, with more meetings planned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: STB and Enterprise Singapore, for example, work on continually having new products and services to liven up and make our nightlife scene more vibrant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: For the transformation of the sector, Enterprise Singapore works closely with SNBA and other players.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And for workers, they have been working together with Workforce Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But I wanted to assure the Member that we have indeed been working very closely with SNBA, through meetings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And we will be organising more later this month to factor in their feedback as well as their suggestions.
